results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if owner/repo is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover accessible repositories using GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORIES_FOR_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER (derive coordinates from returned repository fields).
[Optional (if access is uncertain or coordinates may be wrong)] [Prerequisite]: Validate reachability using GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY (avoid mistaking auth/mismatch for “no issues”).
[Required] [Step]: List items using GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES (apply state/labels/sort; if you need issues-only, exclude entries that include a pull_request field).
[Optional (if results span multiple pages)] [Next Step]: Paginate using GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES (iterate page/per_page until a short/empty page, then merge results).

[Optional (if richer context is needed for selected items)] [Next Step]: Hydrate using GITHUB_GET_AN_ISSUE, then fetch discussion using GITHUB_LIST_ISSUE_COMMENTS (paginate comments; use since only for incremental updates).
[Optional (if multi-page payloads are too large to review inline)] [Step]: Process results in COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH (de-duplicate, compact fields, and split issue vs PR-shaped items).

[Fallback (if listing fails due to access restrictions or you need server-side keyword filtering)] [Fallback]: Query using GITHUB_SEARCH_ISSUES_AND_PULL_REQUESTS (repo-scoped q with is:issue), paginate items, and de-duplicate against any list results.
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES] per_page is capped at 100; large responses may be truncated inline, so paginate and/or post-process the full payload out-of-band when needed.
[GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES] since filters by updated_at (not created_at); use GITHUB_SEARCH_ISSUES_AND_PULL_REQUESTS when creation-time criteria matter.
[GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY] 404 Not Found can indicate wrong coordinates or missing access; validate before assuming the repository or issues don’t exist.
[GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES] 403 Forbidden can occur under organization OAuth restrictions; fall back to GITHUB_SEARCH_ISSUES_AND_PULL_REQUESTS.
[GITHUB_SEARCH_ISSUES_AND_PULL_REQUESTS] repo-scoped q is required; results cap at ~1000 and malformed queries can return 422 Validation Failed.

GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES.description: Lists issues (including pull requests) from a GitHub repository. Requires BOTH 'owner' AND 'repo' parameters (e.g., owner='octocat', repo='Hello-World' for github.com/octocat/Hello-World).

page.description: Page number for the set of results. Refer to GitHub's REST API documentation for pagination details.

repo.description: REQUIRED. The name of the repository (without .git extension). For 'octocat/Hello-World', repo is 'Hello-World'. Not case-sensitive. Must be provided together with 'owner'.

sort.description: The field to sort the results by.

type.description: Filter issues by type name. Use '*' for issues with any type, 'none' for issues without a type, or specify a type name.

owner.description: REQUIRED. The GitHub account owner (user or organization) of the repository. For 'octocat/Hello-World', owner is 'octocat'. Not case-sensitive. Must be provided together with 'repo'.

since.description: Filters issues to include only those updated at or after the specified time. This should be a timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).

state.description: Filters issues based on their state.

labels.description: A comma-separated list of label names to filter issues by. Example: 'bug,ui,@high'.

creator.description: Filter issues by the username of the user who created the issue.

assignee.description: Filter issues by assignee's username. Use 'none' for issues with no assignee, or '*' for issues assigned to any user.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30, which matches GitHub's API default. Refer to GitHub's REST API documentation for pagination details.

mentioned.description: Filter issues by a user mentioned in the issue's description or comments. Provide the username.

milestone.description: Filter issues by milestone. Provide the milestone `number` as a string, '*' for issues with any milestone, or 'none' for issues without a milestone.

GITHUB_GET_AN_ISSUE.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue in a repository using the owner, repository name, and issue number.

repo.description: Name of the repository (without `.git` extension). Not case-sensitive.

owner.description: Username of the account owning the repository. Not case-sensitive.

issue_number.description: The identifying number of the issue.

GITHUB_LIST_ISSUE_COMMENTS.description: Lists comments for a specified issue in a GitHub repository.

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve.

repo.description: Name of the repository, without the `.git` extension (not case-sensitive).

owner.description: Username of the account owning the repository (not case-sensitive).

since.description: Filters comments to include only those updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).

per_page.description: Number of comments to return per page (max 100).
